text: Is any character's face cut off by the edge of the frame?
Is any on-screen text (caption, speech bubble, title) cut off by the frame edge, or drawn over a character's face?
Do any characters or objects visibly intersect or pass through each other (a hand through a table, a body through a wall)?
Is there an obvious rendering glitch: a hard seam or line across a surface, a smear, a stretched texture, or a missing part?
Is any visible word misspelled, garbled or only partly formed?
Is the picture mostly one flat field of colour with no clear subject, so a viewer could not tell what they are looking at?
Is any caption or on-screen text drawn on top of a busy object so that it is hard to read?
Does any character look clearly different from the reference model sheet (wrong colours, wrong proportions, missing features)?
